mapper.insert: INSERT INTO applications (job_id, candidate_id, cv_id, status, cover_letter, source, referral_code, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, transferred_from_id, hm_approved, assigned_department_id, decision_comment, decided_by, decided_at, applied_at, status_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{candidateId}, #{cvId}, #{status}, #{coverLetter}, #{source}, #{referralCode}, #{utmSource}, #{utmMedium}, #{utmCampaign}, #{transferredFromId}, #{hmApproved}, #{assignedDepartmentId}, #{decisionComment}, #{decidedBy}, #{decidedAt}, #{appliedAt}, #{statusChangedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE applications SET status = #{status}, hm_approved = #{hmApproved}, assigned_department_id = #{assignedDepartmentId}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, status_changed_at = #{statusChangedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, candidate_id, cv_id, status, cover_letter, source, referral_code, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, transferred_from_id, hm_approved, assigned_department_id, decision_comment, decided_by, decided_at, applied_at, status_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM applications WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND is_deleted = FALSE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage_transitions (application_id, from_status, to_status, notes, moved_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{notes}, #{movedAt}, #{movedAt}, #{movedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, from_status, to_status, notes, moved_at, created_by FROM stage_transitions WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY moved_at, id
